logTemplate:
<%*
const begin = log.begin.format("HH:mm");
let end = log.end.format("HH:mm");
if (begin === end) {
  end = log.begin.clone().add(1, "minutes").format("HH:mm");
}
const taskName = log.task.name ? log.task.name.replace(/\[🍅::.*?\]/g, "").trim() : "⚡ 割り込み";
if (log.mode == "WORK") {
  const icon = log.finished ? "🍅" : "▶️";
  tR = `- ${begin} - ${end} ${icon} ${taskName} ( ${log.duration} / ${log.session} )`;
} else {
  tR = `- ${begin} - ${end} ☕️ 休憩 (${log.duration} )`;
}
%>
